proposal.quote: will not hesitate to expel all undesirable foreigners ... Gayda then mentions the following “insignificant and suspect” Anglo-Saxon missions which have been dealt with by the Italian authorities
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The Italian Government spokesman's reported expulsion of British and American missions and hostile characterization of Anglo-Saxon missionaries shows Italy estranged from the West in the post-Ethiopia period.

proposal.quote: an article such as Gayda’s would make a most unfavorable impression in the United States and did not help good relations
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The report shows Italy, in the aftermath of its conquest of Ethiopia (the affair falls to the Colonial Ministry in Ethiopia), in friction with a Western power over its Ethiopian policy, which meets the post-Ethiopia estrangement threshold only weakly, so confidence is low.

proposal.quote: That policy has been enacted into law by the Congress of the United States, and with regard to it the Executive Branch of this Government has no discretionary power.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The Secretary of State reports that the strict non-interference policy toward the Spanish conflict is a statutory regime binding the Executive, i.e. the mandatory Neutrality Act embargo regime in force, which meets the isolationist level.

proposal.quote: it was not yet the time to make an effective move towards international agreement particularly with respect to armaments which is essential to a general settlement
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Eden's ministerial statement treats a general settlement as the still-valid objective, only postponing the timing, which fits the limited level.

proposal.quote: rearmament which was forced upon them ... it was not yet the time to make an effective move towards international agreement particularly with respect to armaments which is essential to a general settlement
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Eden reports rearmament as forced upon Britain and a general settlement as the postponed aim, matching appease's defensive rearmament and policy of seeking settlement rather than a standing commitment to fight.

proposal.quote: the passage of the Neutrality Act on January 6[8]th ... in view of my country’s policy of strict neutrality
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the Neutrality Act in force and an explicit policy of strict neutrality under which arms are withheld from a belligerent, matching the isolationist level's neutrality-act regime with an arms embargo.

proposal.quote: all direct or indirect exports of arms to Spain were prohibited by law
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The document reports that exports of arms to Spain were prohibited by law and enforced against transshipment, meeting the isolationist level's mandatory arms-embargo regime.
